children: MongoDB raised its full-year outlook and reported a 30% jump in second-quarter sales, marking its highest level of growth in years. However, in a note published last month, Morgan Stanley analysts say investors had high expectations heading into the report. While the infrastructure services industry is experiencing its best demand environment since 2022, "the challenge heading into results is that the market has picked up on the improving demand trends and shares have rallied significantly over the last 3 months," the analysts say. Shares of MongoDB slide 13%, to $375.82, in late trading. (kelly.cloonan@wsj.com)
